responsibility: This header centralizes function, enum, and helper declarations shared across the H8/300 backend, especially interfaces implemented in h8300.cc and consumed by generated insn-output code and other target files. It exposes instruction emission and length helpers, shift/rotate classification, operand/address predicates, prologue/epilogue and calling-convention hooks, pragma handlers, symbol/data attribute queries, and other target utilities, making it the public prototype surface for the port’s C++ implementation.
